_: Qwen-3.8-35B-A3B (Distill): empero-ai/Qwen3.8-35B-A3B-Distill-GGUF (Apache-2.0), empero-ai's distillation of Qwen/Qwen3.8-35B-A3B, architecture qwen35moe, in its own GGUF - 35B parameters, 256 experts with 8 routed a token, 40 trunk layers (30 GatedDeltaNet, 10 GQA), up to a 256K context. The `mntq` engine runs it from the file in place (tools/iq_pack.py indexes it; the pack is native, so --serve is served from the verify-window loop - qwen35moe has no batched prefill: --prefill 0). "revision" is the commit the files were uploaded at and the file has its sha256: the setup checks it against it. The setup pins Q4_K_M (~21.7 GB); the repo also carries BF16, IQ2_M, Q2_K, IQ3_M, Q3_K_M, IQ4_XS, Q5_K_M, Q6_K and Q8_0. No vision in this file (the repo's mmproj is not needed: the model reads text), and its MTP drafter is built from its NextN block like every model that carries one (tools/mtp_from_gguf.py writes the block's own Q4_K/Q6_K expert bytes, and src/core/mtp.cpp's record_forward_plain is its draft graph); the setup keeps the drafts when the measuring says they are faster.
